features.automaticFinish: Automatic finish when time reaches zero

detailed_description: Typing Speed Test offers fixed 15, 30, 60, and 120 second modes that end automatically when the countdown reaches zero. It calculates WPM, CPM, accuracy, consistency, correct and incorrect character totals, and a character-level error summary directly in your browser. Results are kept only in local history in the current browser: no account is required, and no typing data or history is uploaded to the cloud.
usage_steps: Choose a 15, 30, 60, or 120 second mode and an Easy, Medium, or Hard prompt bank.
Click inside the typing box and begin entering the displayed text.
Watch the character highlighting to catch mistakes while you type.
Keep typing until the countdown reaches zero and the test ends automatically.
Review WPM, CPM, accuracy, consistency, character errors, and the local result history.
Use Restart or Try Again to begin another timed test.
usage_examples: A student checks their WPM before an online writing exam.
A support agent practices accuracy on medium-length sentences before a shift.
A keyboard reviewer compares typing speed and mistake counts across two keyboard layouts.
Transform sample text first, then proofread the result before sharing or publishing.

faqs.question: How is WPM calculated?
faqs.answer: WPM uses the correctly typed character count during the selected fixed duration, with five characters treated as one word. CPM reports the correctly typed characters per minute.

faqs.question: Does the test upload what I type?
faqs.answer: No. Prompts and scoring run in the browser, local history stays in this browser, and the tool does not require an account or cloud storage.

faqs.question: Can I choose the difficulty?
faqs.answer: Yes. Easy, Medium, and Hard choose different built-in prompts with different lengths and complexity.

faqs.question: What happens if I make mistakes?
faqs.answer: Characters are highlighted as you type, and the final result includes a character-level error summary, correct and incorrect totals, WPM, CPM, accuracy, and consistency.

faqs.question: What should I check before using the Typing Speed Test output?
faqs.answer: Review the character error summary and compare local history entries across equal test durations before drawing conclusions about progress.
